name: Capital Program Analyst · Northline Water
business_need: Capital Program Analyst for Northline Water Group's four regulated water utilities (Ardenia, Belmara, Corvale, Dunmoor). Keeps the capital plan, budgets, forecasts and commitments current for 4,500 projects, explains variances above threshold, supports rate cases with in-service evidence, and reports the program to the Capital Steering Committee. Reports to priya.raman@vriodigital.com.

personas.name: SVP Capital Delivery (committee chair)
personas.description: Chairs the Capital Steering Committee. Asks where the program stands, which large projects need a decision, and what goes in the quarterly pack.

personas.name: Capital Controller
personas.description: Asks whether forecasts reconcile to the ledger, whether the year's plan will be spent by December, and what moved since last month.

personas.name: Director, Rate Case and Regulatory
personas.description: Asks which claimed projects will be in service inside the test year, how plant additions compare with the order, and what evidence backs a cost increase.

personas.name: Project Controls Manager
personas.description: Asks which forecasts are stale, which project managers to chase, and which projects moved most since the last round.

personas.name: Treasury and Funding
personas.description: Asks how much cash the program needs by month and how much of it is covered by loans and grants.

metrics.name: Forecast variance
metrics.description: Forecast at completion minus approved budget, per project, from the latest working forecast. Positive means overrun; a large project above 10% needs a WIN budget revision.
metrics.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT f.project_code, f.forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.project_code ORDER BY f.forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast f
)
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, b.approved_budget_usd, l.forecast_at_completion_usd,
       l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd AS variance_usd,
       (l.forecast_at_completion_usd - b.approved_budget_usd) / NULLIF(b.approved_budget_usd, 0) AS variance_pct
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.phase <> 'Closed'

metrics.name: Large projects above 10%
metrics.description: Large projects in delivery whose forecast at completion is more than 10% above the approved budget, with whether a WIN budget revision is raised.
metrics.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, forecast_at_completion_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, b.approved_budget_usd, l.forecast_at_completion_usd,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commitments.win_authorization w
                         WHERE w.project_code = p.project_code AND w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.win_status = 'Pending')
            THEN 'Revision raised' ELSE 'No revision' END AS win_state
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = p.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.large_project = 1 AND p.phase = 'In Delivery'
  AND l.forecast_at_completion_usd > 1.10 * b.approved_budget_usd

metrics.name: Annual plan delivery
metrics.description: Posted to date plus the working forecast to year end, divided by the annual plan. Below 95% means capital moves into next year.
metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.period <= 9 THEN g.posted_usd ELSE m.forecast_usd END) AS expected_fy_usd,
       SUM(m.plan_usd) AS plan_fy_usd
FROM epbcs.monthly_spread m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_code, CAST(RIGHT(fiscal_period, 2) AS INT) AS period, SUM(amount_usd) AS posted_usd
           FROM gl.project_costing_line WHERE fiscal_period LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY project_code, RIGHT(fiscal_period, 2)) g
  ON g.project_code = m.project_code AND g.period = m.period
WHERE m.fiscal_year = 2026 AND m.vintage = 'Working'

metrics.name: Spend vs plan, year to date
metrics.description: Posted actuals in the fiscal year to date divided by the calendarized plan for the same months.
metrics.sql:
SELECT SUM(g.amount_usd) AS posted_ytd_usd,
       (SELECT SUM(m.plan_usd) FROM epbcs.monthly_spread m
        WHERE m.fiscal_year = 2026 AND m.vintage = 'Jan Calendarization' AND m.period <= 9) AS plan_ytd_usd
FROM gl.project_costing_line g
WHERE g.fiscal_period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-09'

metrics.name: Forecast freshness
metrics.description: Active projects whose latest working forecast is older than 45 days, by region and cost tool.
metrics.sql:
SELECT p.region, p.cost_tool, COUNT(*) AS stale_projects, SUM(b.approved_budget_usd) AS budget_usd
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
WHERE p.phase IN ('In Development', 'In Delivery')
  AND (SELECT MAX(f.forecast_date) FROM epbcs.forecast f WHERE f.project_code = p.project_code) < DATEADD(day, -45, '2026-10-15')
GROUP BY p.region, p.cost_tool

metrics.name: Open commitments
metrics.description: Ordered minus received minus cancelled, on open PO lines. Unpaid invoices are not open commitment.
metrics.sql:
SELECT l.project_code, SUM(l.ordered_usd - l.received_usd - l.cancelled_usd) AS open_usd
FROM commitments.po_line l
WHERE l.line_status = 'Open'
GROUP BY l.project_code

metrics.name: Contingency remaining
metrics.description: Contingency still held in the latest forecast divided by contingency at authorization.
metrics.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT project_code, contingency_usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY project_code ORDER BY forecast_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM epbcs.forecast
)
SELECT b.project_code, b.contingency_usd AS contingency_at_approval_usd, l.contingency_usd AS contingency_left_usd
FROM epbcs.plan b
JOIN latest l ON l.project_code = b.project_code AND l.rn = 1
WHERE b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026

metrics.name: Budget revisions waiting
metrics.description: WIN budget revisions requested and not yet approved, by approval level and age.
metrics.sql:
SELECT w.approval_level, COUNT(*) AS pending, SUM(w.amount_usd) AS amount_usd,
       MAX(DATEDIFF(day, w.requested_on, '2026-10-19')) AS oldest_days
FROM commitments.win_authorization w
WHERE w.request_type = 'Budget revision' AND w.win_status = 'Pending'
GROUP BY w.approval_level

metrics.name: Test-year in-service at risk
metrics.description: Projects claimed in service inside a test year whose expected in-service date is now after the test year ends, with the rate base at stake.
metrics.sql:
SELECT r.docket, r.project_code, p.project_name, r.claimed_in_service_by, i.forecast_in_service_date, r.rate_base_usd
FROM pmo.rate_case_claim r
JOIN pmo.project p ON p.project_code = r.project_code
LEFT JOIN upload.inservice i ON i.project_code = r.project_code
WHERE r.claim_status IN ('Claimed', 'Updated')
  AND (i.forecast_in_service_date > r.test_year_end OR i.project_code IS NULL)

hero_questions.text: Which projects have not been re-forecast for more than 45 days?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.region, p.cost_tool, COUNT(*) AS stale_projects, SUM(b.approved_budget_usd) AS budget_usd
FROM pmo.project p
JOIN epbcs.plan b ON b.project_code = p.project_code AND b.plan_vintage = 'Working' AND b.fiscal_year = 2026
WHERE p.phase IN ('In Development', 'In Delivery')
  AND (SELECT MAX(f.forecast_date) FROM epbcs.forecast f WHERE f.project_code = p.project_code) < DATEADD(day, -45, '2026-10-15')
GROUP BY p.region, p.cost_tool

hero_questions.sql:
